title: Macro Meal Planner
description: Build meals from a 42-food nutrition database to hit your protein, carb and fat targets.
howto: Set your daily protein, carbs, and fat targets in grams.
Use the search box to narrow the food list, then add foods with their weight in grams.
Add as many food rows as your meal needs.
Watch the totals and progress bars track against your targets.

faqs.q: Where do the nutrition values come from?
faqs.a: Typical per-100g values in line with USDA data. Brands and cooking methods vary, so treat them as close estimates.
Protein and carbs count 4 kcal per gram, fat counts 9 kcal per gram (Atwater factors).
Yes, in your browser's localStorage, so your plan is still there when you return. Nothing leaves your device.
